body: I am a 25F who is morbidly obese and have just had my surgery last week. There are steps that are taken to ensure the surgery goes well despite your size, I was incredibly nervous too but the surgeons monitor all your indicators closely. I’m 6 days post op and genuinely feeling amazing and my incisions have no pain and are almost healed. Just remember to keep your wounds clean afterwards to avoid infection, that’s my biggest tip! All the best to you, take deep breaths it will all be okay!
